items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I remember being in Iowa before that Lieberman concert in '54

ctx.x: Did you pull out something like "Wild Wings of the Woods" once in a while?
Once in a while we did and I remember being in Iowa before that Lieberman concert in '54--we were at
practice or something--and towards the end of the evening we dragged that thing out and played our part and the people really didn't know what was going on. But some of them kind of liked it.
